title: Ultimate Step
description: UltimateStep is an all-in-one Paper server management plugin featuring a powerful rank system, configurable scoreboard, customizable tablist, and complete punishment tools including warn, mute, ban, kick, unmute, and unban. Lightweight, modern, and easy
body:
# UltimateStep

**A complete management plugin for modern Paper servers.**

UltimateStep is an all-in-one administration plugin for Paper servers. It combines ranks, scoreboard, tablist, punishments, chat moderation, utility commands, economy, homes, staff tools, security features, Discord logging, and GUI-based management in one lightweight and configurable plugin.

Perfect for **Survival**, **CityBuild**, **MiniGames**, **Community**, and **Network** servers.

---

## Requirements

- Paper **1.21.1+**
- Java **21**
- Optional: LuckPerms
- Optional: Vault

LuckPerms and Vault are supported as soft dependencies and are not required.

---

## Features

### Core

- `/us` main command
- `/us reload` reloads the plugin
- `/us en`, `/us de`, `/us es` language switching
- Module system via `/ssettings`
- Config and messages system
- English, German, and Spanish message files

### Scoreboard

- Sidebar scoreboard
- Animated title
- Configurable refresh interval
- Can be disabled anytime
- Lightweight automatic updates

**Placeholders**

- `%player%`
- `%rank%`
- `%online%`
- `%bans%`
- `%coins%`
- `%ping%`
- `%world%`

### Tablist

- Custom header and footer
- Online player display
- Staff online display
- Ping display
- Sorting by rank
- Nametag prefix and suffix through ranks

### Ranks

- Built-in rank system
- List ranks
- Show rank information
- Set player ranks
- Prefix and suffix support
- Weight-based sorting
- Plugin owner protection

Configuration Files
UltimateStep generates all important files automatically.

File	Description
config.yml	Main settings, modules, scoreboard, tablist, messages, and general options
ranks.yml	Rank names, prefixes, suffixes, permissions, weights, and inheritance
messages_en.yml	English messages
messages_de.yml	German messages
messages_es.yml	German messages
punishments.yml	Stored punishments, reports, notes, and cases
player-ranks.yml	Player rank storage
Installation
Put the .jar file into your plugins/ folder.
Start the server.
Let UltimateStep generate all files.
Edit your ranks, modules, scoreboard, tablist, and messages.
Reload or restart the server.
Done.
Why UltimateStep?
Most servers need many separate plugins for administration, ranks, punishments, chat, economy, homes, and staff tools.
